one_surface_only.text: Ancient Trees is a passion project. I'm building it to let others appreciate nature and go outside. Marvel at something older than you can imagine.
one_surface_only.reason: The sponsor page is web-only by design. The app's sponsor sheet was taken out of the build while the paywall line settles; the page on the website stays.

one_surface_only.text: Running the website and app does cost money. A donation would help me enormously: more time and more resources to make this much better, and to get more of these trees on the map.

one_surface_only.reason: The link to that same web-only sponsor page.
The /contribute page and its footer link are web-only; the app adds a tree through the camera, which is its own flow and its own words.

Two different features that happened to share three words. In the app it heads the identify stage of the camera flow, when a photograph matches several trees nearby (CollectSheet.identifyState). The website used the same words as the heading over a tree page's recognition line, and that heading was taken out in the 2026-09-04 tree-block redesign. Nothing on the website asks somebody to pick between candidate trees.
